# pdf-decrypt-wasm

> Browser-only JavaScript package that decrypts a password-protected PDF locally using QPDF compiled to WebAssembly. The PDF and password are not uploaded.

- Author: HafzalBZ
- Source: https://github.com/HafzalBZ/pdf-decrypt-wasm
- Issues: https://github.com/HafzalBZ/pdf-decrypt-wasm/issues

## Install

`npm install pdf-decrypt-wasm`

## Canonical usage

```js
import { decryptPdf, PdfDecryptError } from 'pdf-decrypt-wasm';

try {
  const bytes = await decryptPdf(file, password);
  const blob = new Blob([bytes], { type: 'application/pdf' });
} catch (error) {
  if (error instanceof PdfDecryptError && error.code === 'WRONG_PASSWORD') {
    // Ask the user to enter the password again.
  }
}
```

## API

- `decryptPdf(input, password, options?): Promise<Uint8Array>`
- `isPdfDecryptSupported(): boolean`
- `PdfDecryptError` with a stable `code` property
- Inputs: `File`, `Blob`, `ArrayBuffer`, or typed-array view
- Options: `timeout`, `maxFileSize`, `workerUrl`
- Default timeout: 60 seconds
- Default maximum file size: 100 MiB

## Important constraints

- Browser only; do not use as a Node.js PDF library.
- Requires WebAssembly and module workers.
- Serve over HTTP or HTTPS, not `file://`.
- Serve `.wasm` with `Content-Type: application/wasm`.
- This decrypts with a password supplied by the user. It does not crack or recover passwords.
- The output is an unencrypted copy of the PDF.
